runtime.command:
(
set -euo pipefail
out="reports/seller_alias_continual/20260907/cpu_check/$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
mkdir "$out"
printf 'CPU_CHECK_OUTPUT=%s\n' "$out"
date --iso-8601=seconds > "$out/started_at.txt"
python -B -VV > "$out/environment.log"
set +e
nice -n 10 python -u -B scripts/step28_continual_core.py check --output "$out/runtime.json" 2>&1 | tee "$out/run.log"
status=$?
printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$out/exit_status.txt"
date --iso-8601=seconds > "$out/finished_at.txt"
printf 'CPU_CHECK_EXIT_STATUS=%s\n' "$status"
exit "$status"
)
